title: One-day polyurea flake garage-floor coatings
one_liner: Grind + polyurea base + decorative flake + polyaspartic topcoat for garages in one day; price upfront on Meta ads (~$/sq ft) and quote fast.
evidence_quote: I sat down with Mike Stuart… concrete coatings business… garage floor coatings… $60,000 a month… Facebook ads… upfront about pricing… startup costs, material costs, pricing, ad spend, margins
why_it_works: Visual before/after content converts; same-day polyurea turnaround beats overnight epoxy; price-in-ad qualifies buyers. Mechanism from public interview — not a results guarantee.
notes: Also detailed in newsletter.chrisjkoerner.com/p/a-one-day-job-that-brings-in-6k-f5c8 (Old Cap Coatings). No income guarantees.

title: Cottage-food micro bakery from a front porch / home kitchen
one_liner: Bake sourdough, rolls, cookies, bagels under cottage-food rules; preorders + Saturday porch pickup; seed demand with short-form video.
evidence_quote: Angela Henson… Little Bit Bakery, a home bakery doing around $2,000 in sales every Saturday morning… sourdough, cinnamon rolls, cookies and bagels… preorders… one simple TikTok helped the business take off… cottage food laws
why_it_works: Cottage-food laws lower CapEx; preorders kill waste; local pickup + short-form proof creates Saturday sell-outs. Public podcast cite — not a results promise.
notes: Ep #335 Apple show notes. YT may lag; public Apple cite kept. No income guarantees.

title: Modern attended laundromat across from 'zombie mats'
one_liner: Open a clean, card-pay, attended laundromat in a dense pocket of outdated competitors; grand-open with free laundry weekends + postcard blitz.
evidence_quote: Tyler Purcell… four laundromats in Ohio… 40% profit margin… strategies he uses to outperform competitors… Grand Opening Strategies… Commercial vs. Residential Laundry Services
why_it_works: Necessity demand + weak dirty competitors; free-weekend habit transfer and modern payments pull share. Public interview mechanism — not a guarantee.
notes: Related Laundry Spot franchise deep-dive Ep #334 Apple. Distinct from multi-store portfolio idea already in corpus.

title: Commercial / wash-fold B2B laundry routes on a modern mat
one_liner: Attach commercial account laundry and wash-and-fold routes to a modern laundromat using large machines + remote ops tech.
evidence_quote: Laundry Spot… flagship… Hamilton, Ohio… 130-pound washing machine, proprietary detergent system, commercial laundry operation, and the technology they use to manage the business remotely
why_it_works: Self-serve retail covers base load; commercial accounts add daytime utilization on big machines. Public show notes — not a results promise.
notes: Ep #334. Pair with modern-mat play; franchise path mentioned (laundryspot.com) — Brandon gates any franchise money.

title: Digital waiver micro-SaaS for churches / events / rentals
one_liner: Vibe-code a simple paid waiver app (Stripe) for orgs that still use paper; acquire first customers via Meta + Reddit without an audience.
evidence_quote: building a real app with Replit… OnlyWaivers… frustrating problem from my church… accepting payments… Facebook ads and promoting it on Reddit… first sale
why_it_works: Narrow painful workflow + instant checkout; cold Meta/Reddit tests product before audience. Build-in-public demo — not a revenue claim.
notes: onlywaivers.com referenced in description. Pattern generalizes to other paper-form niches.

title: Buy distressed ice/water vending machines and relocate
one_liner: Hunt underperforming ice/water machines for pennies-on-the-dollar, move to proven high-traffic pads, monitor remotely with lean maintenance.
evidence_quote: CJ Lovas… ice and water vending machine business… what makes a great location… how he finds distressed machines for pennies on the dollar… real costs, margins and maintenance… four locations with no full-time employees… monitors most of the business from his phone
why_it_works: Location quality dominates; distressed buy lowers CapEx vs new; remote monitoring keeps headcount low. Distinct from greenfield ice-vending idea already cataloged.
notes: Thin wedge vs idea-mhp_guy-ice-water-vending-001 (ops focus here is distressed acquisition).

title: Overnight AI bookkeeping catch-up for small businesses
one_liner: Take bank statements/receipts at EOD, reconcile with long-running AI overnight, deliver cleaned books by morning as overflow for bookkeepers or direct to SMBs.
evidence_quote: five business ideas… An overnight financial cleanup… Small businesses fall behind on their books… drop in the bank statements, spreadsheets, and receipts… reconcile everything overnight… clean set of books by morning
why_it_works: Tedious overflow work is chronically declined; overnight SLA is a clear wedge. Use model-agnostic process so tool shutdowns don't kill the offer.
notes: Also in newsletter.chrisjkoerner.com/p/5-ways-to-make-money-from-the-ai-that-s-back-61ca. No income guarantees.

title: AI-assisted legacy system migration for SMBs
one_liner: Find firms stuck on outdated stacks (e.g. QuickBooks Desktop) via BuiltWith/Outscraper and productize migrations onto modern tools with AI doing the tedious convert work.
evidence_quote: A legacy system migration… agencies charging… to move companies off ancient software… Use a tool like BuiltWith or Outscraper… QuickBooks Desktop instead of QuickBooks Online
why_it_works: Owners know they must update but lack bandwidth; scoped migrations sell outcomes not AI jargon.
notes: Companion YT https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q_FIJmSB0Ro. Model-risk noted in source — treat AI as engine not whole business.

title: Deep-personalization email service for gyms & medspas
one_liner: Sell AI-written hyper-personalized email campaigns to local gyms/medspas that have lists but no strategy; demo 1–2 sample emails then retain.
evidence_quote: Deep personalization- at scale… pull eight to twelve pieces of relevant detail into every email… A gym or a med spa with an email list and no strategy is a perfectly good first client
why_it_works: Lists exist; personalization is too slow by hand; demo emails make the sale concrete.
notes: Cite also q_FIJmSB0Ro. Compliance/CAN-SPAM is a human gate.

title: Portfolio of AI-built niche affiliate / local guide sites
one_liner: Spin up many small directory/review/guide sites in niches with search demand; let long-running AI maintain content/SEO while you stack modest affiliate/ad cashflow.
evidence_quote: Building small digital assets that maintain themselves… tiny websites- directory sites, niche review sites, local guide sites… Build five, ten, sometimes dozens… Fable can build these sites and keep optimizing
why_it_works: Many small assets beat one hero site; AI removes content/ops bottleneck. Diversify models so one shutdown doesn't kill portfolio.
notes: Newsletter twin has mover/home-inspector/photographer niche examples.

title: Productized AI design studio with one-request queues
one_liner: Sell a capped monthly design retainer (one request in queue) where AI does production and you own QA + client relationship — solo-scaleable.
evidence_quote: A productized service agency… one person design studio… standardize the offer so a client can only have one request in the queue at a time, and let the model do the production work while you manage quality and relationships
why_it_works: Queue cap protects quality; AI expands throughput without hiring a bench. Public framing references design operators — not a results promise.
notes: Related interview cited in NL: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bAzg8BugEVY

title: Lead-gen site rental for radon mitigation (mid-ticket niche)
one_liner: Build city+service sites for radon mitigation in 60k–500k metros with weak map-packs; rent leads flat or rev-share to operators who answer the phone.
evidence_quote: Towing lands right in the middle, and so do tree service, pest control, radon mitigation, carpet cleaning… cities between 60,000- 500,000… exact-match domain… Renting it out… revenue share
why_it_works: Mid-ticket + owner answers phone; thinner SEO wars than roofing/plumbing in big cities. Distinct niche focus vs generic leadgen-site-rental already cataloged.
notes: Companion YT https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ErnEr2JcD0. Thin niche vs idea-mhp_guy-leadgen-site-rental-001.

title: Building-permit → first-call temporary fence prospecting
one_liner: Pull public building permits weeks before dirt moves, call GC/foreman first, sell temp fence with deposit funding panels — zero-inventory start.
evidence_quote: Temporary Fence Rentals… Building permits are public record and get filed weeks or months before anyone shows up on site. Pull them, call the number on the construction banner, and you're the first call… Sell the first job, take a deposit up front, then buy your panels with their cash
why_it_works: Permit data is an unfair timing edge; customer deposit finances inventory. Thin go-to-market wedge vs owning the fence fleet idea already in corpus.
notes: Companion ep https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dTnidR4eLus. Distinct from idea-mhp_guy-temp-fence-rental-001 (ops) — this is permit-first GTM.

title: GBP + one-page converter retainer for local trades
one_liner: Land owners in person first; fix Google Business Profile/reviews, ship a problem-first one-pager, then retain for owned blog/podcast content from owner voice memos.
evidence_quote: Fix their Google Business Profile first… Build one page that converts… headline, a short video, some social proof, and one obvious button… Ask the owner to name 50 problems… answer each one out loud while you record… AI cleans the transcript into a blog post
why_it_works: GBP is free leverage; one-pager focuses conversion; voice→content removes owner writing friction. Complements jingle ads already harvested.
notes: Ep #328. Distinct from idea-mhp_guy-local-jingle-yt-ads-001 (ads layer) — this is GBP+page+owned content retainer.

title: Amazon Influencer Creator Connections boost focus
one_liner: After 20–30 approved shoppable videos, prioritize Creator Connections boosted-commission ASINs; optional free product → FBMP resale stack.
evidence_quote: Creator Connections, where brands offer boosted rates of 10, 20, even 50 percent… Once you have posted twenty or thirty videos, you unlock access… brands start sending you products for free… resell those on Facebook Marketplace
why_it_works: Boosted rates dwarf standard commissions; free product adds a second cash path. Thin scaling play on top of base Amazon Influencer idea.
notes: Companion YT https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nVgFbclwmSA. Distinct from idea-mhp_guy-amazon-influencer-reviews-001.

title: On-device AI hardware install & workflow setup for SMBs
one_liner: Productize installing privacy-first plug-in AI devices and training local workflows across desktop apps for Main Street operators who won't cloud their data.
evidence_quote: Violoop… plug-in AI device that works alongside you on your computer… learn how you work, help with repetitive tasks, handle workflows across different apps… privacy, on-device AI, business use cases
why_it_works: Privacy-sensitive owners resist pure cloud agents; hardware+setup is a tangible install SKU. Sponsored episode — treat as mechanism not endorsement.
notes: Kickstarter/community links in description. Implementation agency framing, not reselling claims.

title: Acquire a boring business and inject one AI workflow
one_liner: Identify an AI workflow with clear labor/revenue lift (e.g. home-health charting dictation), then buy a business where that workflow applies day one.
evidence_quote: Identify a specific AI workflow that increases revenue or reduces labor costs significantly, then acquire a business where you can implement it immediately… home health company and automate charting via AI dictation
why_it_works: Value unlock is pre-specified before capital; buy ops you can improve not invent. Distinct from sweat-equity partnership (no buy) already in corpus.
notes: Also ideakoerner.com/idea/49-buy-a-business-and-add-ai-value citing same YT. No income guarantees.

title: One-door-down niche pick next to saturated HVAC
one_liner: When HVAC digital competition is thick, score adjacent high-ticket locals (one door down) with the same Maps→gap→Meta machine and take the emptier room.
evidence_quote: Why to go one door down from HVAC… How to pick which businesses to target… Real example: 20 Atlanta HVAC companies, all with the same 3 leaks… Lead gen with hyperlocal Facebook ads
why_it_works: Same buyer psychology as HVAC without the crowded creative auction; gap patterns often shared across adjacent trades.
notes: BM YT The Best AI Business Doesn't Touch AI. Thin targeting SOP vs broader Main Street AI firm ideas.

title: Maps scrape → AI gap-score → named-owner pitch PDF desk
one_liner: Zapier/Apify scrape Google Maps, AI flags site leaks (no click-to-call / no offer / no email capture), auto-build a custom pitch with the owner's name for outbound.
evidence_quote: scrape Google Maps with Apify, read each site and let AI flag the leak (no email capture, no click-to-call, no offer), then auto-build a custom pitch with the owner's name on it
why_it_works: Named assets beat generic AI pitches; leak taxonomy is repeatable across a niche. Distinct from full market-blitz SOP — this is the scoring+asset desk.
notes: Free skill linked in video description. Overlaps lightly with main-street machine — kept as executable scoring desk.

title: AI short-form video social agent (Replicate + ElevenLabs + Buffer)
one_liner: Run a Zapier-MCP agent that generates short videos (Replicate), voiceovers (ElevenLabs), and publishes via Buffer — sell as done-for-you social for boring brands.
evidence_quote: I built a social media agent that creates and publishes AI videos… Zapier MCP (ElevenLabs, Buffer, MusicGPT) + Replicate… Creating video content with Replicate… AI voiceovers with ElevenLabs… Publishing to LinkedIn via Buffer
why_it_works: Video production is the bottleneck for local brands; MCP removes brittle custom API glue. Distinct from text/Buffer skill already harvested.
notes: Free skill on GitHub per description. No income guarantees.

title: Newsletter→week-of-social atomizer desk for client newsletters
one_liner: Productize Claude Desktop + Zapier MCP + Content Atomizer skill to turn a client's Beehiiv issue into a scheduled week of LinkedIn/social with images.
evidence_quote: no-code marketing workflow… newsletter and social tools so one newsletter turns into a full week of posts… Content Atomizer… Beehiiv… Buffer… Designing the images + loading Buffer
why_it_works: Creators/operators already write weekly; atomization multiplies distribution without new ideas. Client-desk framing vs personal ops skill already in corpus.
notes: Thin vs idea-boringmarketer-newsletter-to-social-content-ops-038 — this is DFY client desk packaging.

title: Application-gated 2–3 client AI firm per city niche
one_liner: Pick one high-ticket niche, ship an asset pack with receipts, run hyperlocal Meta, accept only 2–3 applications, film the case study, then productize workflows.
evidence_quote: pick one high ticket local niche… create an asset pack… run a hyper local meta ads campaign… say you're working with 2-3 in the area with an application flow, get a case study, film another video… rinse and repeat
why_it_works: Scarcity + application flow raises close quality; case-study flywheel funds the next city. Thin operating cadence vs broader Main Street AI firm idea.
notes: Deduped against ai-services-main-street-022 — kept as scarcity/application SOP.
